answer_1.quote: Automatic generation of counterspeech has been researched to support timely and effective efforts to fight hate speech.

answer_2.quote: The generated counterspeech is evaluated by stylistic metrics commonly used in previous studies . We calculate the similarity of counterspeech against a reference dataset... with the BLEU score, ROUGE, METEOR, and BERTScore. The quality of generated texts is evaluated by the GRUEN metrics... Finally, we calculate the type-token ratio and distinct-n-grams to evaluate the diversity of generated texts.

answer_3.quote: We use the conversation incivility level classifier and the hater reentry classifier... to make predictions with the hate speech and generated counterspeech pairs.

answer_4.quote: Additionally, we conduct human assessments for reliability purposes. The human assessment focuses on three characteristics of replies to hate speech: suitability, relevance, and effectiveness.
answer_4.guideline: Human assessment on suitability, relevance, and effectiveness of replies to hate speech.
